--src: Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.Real
theorem rpow_add_of_nonneg (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hz : 0 ≤ z) :
    x ^ (y + z) = x ^ y * x ^ z := by
  rcases hy.eq_or_lt with (rfl | hy)
  · rw [zero_add, rpow_zero, one_mul]
  exact rpow_add' hx (ne_of_gt <| add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg hy hz)

--src: Mathlib.Data.Real.Sqrt
/-- Bernoulli's inequality for exponent `1 / 2`, stated using `sqrt`. -/
theorem sqrt_one_add_le (h : -1 ≤ x) : √(1 + x) ≤ 1 + x / 2 := by
  refine sqrt_le_iff.mpr ⟨by linarith, ?_⟩
  calc 1 + x
    _ ≤ 1 + x + (x / 2) ^ 2 := le_add_of_nonneg_right <| sq_nonneg _
    _ = _ := by ring

--src: Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Integrals
theorem integral_mul_rpow_one_add_sq {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ -1) :
    (∫ x : ℝ in a..b, x * (↑1 + x ^ 2) ^ t) =
      (↑1 + b ^ 2) ^ (t + 1) / (↑2 * (t + ↑1)) - (↑1 + a ^ 2) ^ (t + 1) / (↑2 * (t + ↑1)) := by
  have : ∀ x s : ℝ, (((↑1 + x ^ 2) ^ s : ℝ) : ℂ) = (1 + (x : ℂ) ^ 2) ^ (s : ℂ) := by
    intro x s
    norm_cast
    rw [ofReal_cpow, ofReal_add, ofReal_pow, ofReal_one]
    exact add_nonneg zero_le_one (sq_nonneg x)
  rw [← ofReal_inj]
  convert integral_mul_cpow_one_add_sq (_ : (t : ℂ) ≠ -1)
  · rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_ofReal]
    congr with x : 1
    rw [ofReal_mul, this x t]
  · simp_rw [ofReal_sub, ofReal_div, this a (t + 1), this b (t + 1)]
    push_cast; rfl
  · rw [← ofReal_one, ← ofReal_neg, Ne, ofReal_inj]
    exact ht

--src: Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.Real
lemma rpow_sub_one' (hx : 0 ≤ x) (h : y - 1 ≠ 0) : x ^ (y - 1) = x ^ y / x := by
  rw [rpow_sub' hx h, rpow_one]

--src: Mathlib.Data.Complex.Exponential
theorem quadratic_le_exp_of_nonneg {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) : 1 + x + x ^ 2 / 2 ≤ exp x :=
  calc
    1 + x + x ^ 2 / 2 = ∑ i ∈ range 3, x ^ i / i ! := by
        simp only [sum_range_succ, range_one, sum_singleton, _root_.pow_zero, factorial, cast_one,
          ne_eq, one_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, div_self, pow_one, mul_one, div_one, Nat.mul_one,
          cast_succ, add_right_inj]
        ring_nf
    _ ≤ exp x := sum_le_exp_of_nonneg hx 3

--src: Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.Real
/-- Guessing rule for the `bound` tactic: when trying to prove `x ^ y ≤ x ^ z`, we can either assume
`1 ≤ x` or `0 < x ≤ 1`. -/
@[bound] lemma rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le_or_ge {x y z : ℝ}
    (h : 1 ≤ x ∧ y ≤ z ∨ 0 < x ∧ x ≤ 1 ∧ z ≤ y) : x ^ y ≤ x ^ z := by
  rcases h with ⟨x1, yz⟩ | ⟨x0, x1, zy⟩
  · exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le x1 yz
  · exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge x0 x1 zy

--src: Mathlib.Data.Complex.Exponential
nonrec theorem sin_three_mul : sin (3 * x) = 3 * sin x - 4 * sin x ^ 3 := by
  rw [← ofReal_inj]; simp [sin_three_mul]

--src: Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Inverse
theorem arccos_nonneg (x : ℝ) : 0 ≤ arccos x := by
  unfold arccos; linarith [arcsin_le_pi_div_two x]

--src: Mathlib.Topology.UnitInterval
theorem add_pos {t : I} {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) : 0 < (x + t : ℝ) :=
  add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg hx <| nonneg _

--src: Mathlib.Data.Real.Sqrt
@[simp]
theorem sqrt_mul' (x) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y) : √(x * y) = √x * √y := by
  rw [mul_comm, sqrt_mul hy, mul_comm]

/-- The relation `≤` on a preorder is transitive. -/
@[trans] lemma le_trans : a ≤ b → b ≤ c → a ≤ c := Preorder.le_trans _ _ _

@[simp]
theorem mul_neg (a b : α) : a * -b = -(a * b) :=
  HasDistribNeg.mul_neg _ _

context.name: abs_le
context.content: theorem abs_le : |a| ≤ b ↔ -b ≤ a ∧ a ≤ b := by rw [abs_le', and_comm, neg_le]

context.content:
@[bound]
lemma mul_le_one₀ (ha : a ≤ 1) (hb₀ : 0 ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ 1) : a * b ≤ 1 :=
  one_mul (1 : M₀) ▸ mul_le_mul ha hb hb₀ zero_le_one

context.name: mul_le_one₀
context.content:
@[bound]
lemma mul_le_one₀ (ha : a ≤ 1) (hb₀ : 0 ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ 1) : a * b ≤ 1 :=
  one_mul (1 : M₀) ▸ mul_le_mul ha hb hb₀ zero_le_one

context.name: abs_mul
context.content:
lemma abs_mul (a b : α) : |a * b| = |a| * |b| := by
  rw [abs_eq (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg a) (abs_nonneg b))]
  rcases le_total a 0 with ha | ha <;> rcases le_total b 0 with hb | hb <;>
    simp only [abs_of_nonpos, abs_of_nonneg, true_or, or_true, eq_self_iff_true, neg_mul,
      mul_neg, neg_neg, *]

context.name: abs_mul
context.content:
lemma abs_mul (a b : α) : |a * b| = |a| * |b| := by
  rw [abs_eq (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg a) (abs_nonneg b))]
  rcases le_total a 0 with ha | ha <;> rcases le_total b 0 with hb | hb <;>
    simp only [abs_of_nonpos, abs_of_nonneg, true_or, or_true, eq_self_iff_true, neg_mul,
      mul_neg, neg_neg, *]

context.name: abs
context.content: @[to_additive "`abs a`, denoted `|a|`, is the absolute value of `a`"]

context.name: trans
context.content: lemma trans [IsTrans α r] : a ≺ b → b ≺ c → a ≺ c := IsTrans.trans _ _ _

context.name: le_of_not_le
context.content: lemma le_of_not_le : ¬a ≤ b → b ≤ a := (le_total a b).resolve_left
